title: Planner performance - Quick wins
content:
The following was shared by in the Kombinera team, and summarizes a bunch of quick wins for performance.

I've explored what ikea can do today on planner sites in regard of performance and a little list of it:

  • Images:

pros: up to date image extensions such as webp conversion.

cons: srcset could be a thing here which isnt supported atm. To make sure a small image size is loaded on phones. ( i've contacted kompis on this part and they are looking into it )

  • Minification of code:

pros: most planners use webpack with minify for js, css and html

cons: no cons here, maybe better minifiers.

  • Requests:

Lots of requests to dexf and services, although we have http2, in seo its still recommended to decrease the amount of requests.

Solution: Maybe bundle the product data requests instead?

  • First meaningful content:

Common symptom today is white screen for a little while which is red flag in seo.

Solution: Make sure to load all required css with styled components ( only css used in the page that is loaded ), wait with loading most of the javascript, for example the 3D scene until after everything else is loaded.

  • Assets:

Today all 3D objects is hosted on each planner repo.

Solution: It would be better to share a server, to make sure assets is cached between planners.

Today all 3D assets is only RT ( realtime ) versions which takes lots of unnecessary space.

Solution: We should be able to use different LOD versions of a model, like load a low res first and then afterwards load the highres in the background
